name: Citrus Marinated Tofu over Quinoa Salad with Berries & Oranges
ingredients: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
In a medium saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest oranges into a medium bowl (set oranges aside for later use). Juice lime into the same bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the lime juice, along with soy sauce, oil, and spices. Whisk to combine the marinade.
Meanwhile, cut the tofu planks in half and then cut each half into 4 triangles. Place tofu in the bowl with the marinade and gently toss to coat; set aside. (Reserve baking sheet for later use.)
Juice lemons into a large bowl; add oil, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and cut celery and green onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice strawberries; add to the bowl along with the blueberries.
Remove peel from the zested oranges; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the salad, and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, transfer the cooked quinoa to the baking sheet. Spread out in an even layer and let cool for 5 minutes.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the tofu and marinade; cook the tofu until golden brown, 2-3 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Add cooled quinoa to the bowl with the salad and gently stir to combine.
To serve, divide quinoa salad and tofu between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
